deploy-bot: [ALERT] pipeline 'main' failed after merge by @frank — job smoke/gpu-alloc exited 137. CI link: https://ci.redwood/invocation/1756004321 :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Logs snippet:
```
[2026-08-02T14:23:11Z] ERROR: GPU allocator failed to reserve 8192MB on /dev/nvme0n1: Out of memory
[2026-08-02T14:23:11Z] kvcache: kvalloc returned NULL
[2026-08-02T14:23:12Z] aborting test with exit code 137
```
Alice: @oncall-sre ping — this came in right after a small scheduler change merged in #4821, not sure if related. :eyes:
Ben: Ugh. I was the PR author for the scheduler tweak. I only changed task bookkeeping; didn't touch alloc path. I'll look now.
Carlos: Can someone rerun the job before we do anything drastic? sometimes flakes. /ci rerun smoke/gpu-alloc (or click the CI link).
Dana: Rerun kicked off. If it fails again we should capture full dmesg + nvml log.
deploy-bot: Rerun started by Dana (build 1756004322).
Dana: Still red on rerun, same exit 137, same allocator error. Not a transient spike. :frowning:
Ben: Okay pulling logs. Quick grep shows increased kvalloc churn around 14:22 — looks like many small allocations, then a burst. Could be a regression in prefix caching causing memory blowup.
Carlos: Suggest bisecting between previous green (commit abc123) and current merge. If someone can pin the merge SHA we can do git bisect on the infra image.
Alice: Merge SHA is def456 (from the CI header). Ben, can you bisect? You're closest to the change.
Ben: I can but I'll be offline in 30m for a meeting. If I start bisect now I might not finish. Who can pick up if I stop?
Carlos: I can grab it. Start bisecting, leave notes. Also can you upload the failing container image to gcr and share the digest? that speeds local repro.
Ben: Uploaded: gcr.redwood/dev/smoke:1756004321-digest sha256:9f8a... Link: https://gcr.redwood/9f8a
Dana: @Carlos to repro locally, run with --kv-debug and monitor /proc/meminfo. Command I used:
```
docker run --gpus all --rm -e KV_DEBUG=1 gcr.redwood/dev/smoke:1756004321-digest ./run_smoke.sh --batch 1
```
Carlos: Reproduced locally within a few minutes. Memory climbs steadily until OOM on my dev box. This points to a workload-triggered regression, not infra flake. I'll start bisect and open a draft revert if needed.
oncall-sre: Noting potential customer impact — rolling alert to SRE. If we need an emergency revert, let's follow the playbook and coordinate a maint window.
Alice: Thanks Carlos. If we confirm it's the scheduler tweak, prefer a small revert to restore main while we investigate. Keep the thread updated.
Ben: Leaving notes in the PR and will make a bisect branch before my meeting. Good catch Carlos. :thumbsup:
Carlos: Found culprit commit in bisect: 7a1e2b4 changed task queue compaction timing and indirectly increases short-lived allocations. Drafting revert PR now.
Dana: Nice. Can you add a smoke test that hits the allocation pattern so we don't regress?
Carlos: Yep adding a targeted test and will link PR here. Revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4830 (draft).
Alice: Once CI for the revert is green, let's rollout revert to main. Also add an annotation to the change log for postmortem.
Ben: Back from meeting — if revert lands and main is green, I'll follow up with a patch that fixes the allocation behavior with better pooling.
Carlos: Revert merged, CI is running for main revert (build 1756004489).
deploy-bot: Build 1756004489 for main passed. All smoke jobs green.
Alice: Great work everyone. Marking this as owner-resolved, Carlos for follow-up on test + fix.
Carlos: Will open the fix PR and the postmortem doc. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
